builtinDescriptions.role-packs: Version-locked, auditable finance, legal, HR, operations, admin, research, teaching, and content workflows. High-risk outputs always require human final review.
builtinDescriptions.knowledge-retrieval: Find and cite relevant knowledge from your library and external sources.
builtinDescriptions.canvas-note: Turn ideas into structured notes, summaries, and reusable snippets.
builtinDescriptions.vfs-memory: Store, recall, and update long-term memory snippets and references.
builtinDescriptions.learning-resource: Curate learning resources and suggest study materials.
builtinDescriptions.todo-tools: Create, update, and track tasks with a structured todo list.
builtinDescriptions.anki-tools: Generate, manage, and export Anki cards from learning materials.
builtinDescriptions.qbank-tools: Create and manage question banks with tagging and practice modes.
builtinDescriptions.workspace-tools: Multi-agent workspace collaboration, plus local file reads, artifact writes, and approved shell command execution within authorized folders.
builtinDescriptions.file-manager-tools: Preview-bound batch rename, move, reversible delete, restore, and explicit text format conversion inside the read-write workspace with item-level conflict checks.
builtinDescriptions.web-fetch: Fetch and summarize web content when up-to-date info is needed.
builtinDescriptions.subagent-worker: Delegate sub-tasks to specialized subagents and merge results.
builtinDescriptions.tutor-mode: Socratic tutor that guides learning through questions and hints.
builtinDescriptions.chatanki: End-to-end pipeline to turn documents into reviewable Anki cards.
builtinDescriptions.literature-review: Plan and draft literature reviews from papers and notes.
builtinDescriptions.card-forge-mode: Focused card generation mode with structured prompts and review.
builtinDescriptions.research-mode: Deep research mode for exploration, synthesis, and citations.
builtinDescriptions.deep-student: Default learning strategy that combines memory production/consumption with lightweight user questioning.
builtinDescriptions.dstu-memory-orchestrator: Default memory strategy: local-first unified retrieval, selective memory consumption, and gated long-term memory writes.
builtinDescriptions.mindmap-tools: Create and organize mind maps from topics and notes.
builtinDescriptions.attachment-tools: Parse and extract text or metadata from uploaded files.
builtinDescriptions.docx-tools: Read, write, and edit DOCX documents with structured extraction, table parsing, metadata queries, file generation, round-trip editing, and text replacement.
builtinDescriptions.pptx-tools: Read, write, and edit PPTX presentations with structured extraction, file generation, round-trip editing, and text replacement.
builtinDescriptions.xlsx-tools: Read, write, and edit XLSX spreadsheets with structured extraction, table parsing, file generation, round-trip editing, cell editing, and text replacement.
builtinDescriptions.session-manager: Manage sessions with listing, grouping, tagging, archiving, and batch operations.
builtinDescriptions.ask-user: Ask the user for confirmation or additional information.
builtinDescriptions.academic-search: Search academic papers, literature, and research resources.
builtinDescriptions.template-designer: Design and manage reusable document templates.
builtinDescriptions.workbench-tools: Workbench window control: list windows, open/focus apps, send window commands, close windows, and query state. Use domain tools for data edits.
builtinDescriptions.generative-ui: Emit structured generative UI intents (cards, progress, action bars) rendered by the component registry. No HTML/JS.
builtinDescriptions.media-tools: Transcribe managed audio through the configured external ASR provider and write an auditable transcript artifact.
builtinDescriptions.office-fidelity-tools: Inspect managed DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and PDF files for fidelity risks without executing macros, decrypting files, or claiming unsupported preservation.
